newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU investment expected to rise slightly in 1997.
newsitem.headline: EU investment expected to rise slightly in 1997.

text.p: The European Commission said on Tuesday said it expected investment spending in the European Union manufacturing sector to rise two percent in 1997.
By comparison Greece, the Netherlands and Britain are all expected to show double-digit increases in industrial investment plans during the year, the Commission found in a wide-ranging survey.

The latest survey, conducted during October and November, also showed a downward revision in the pace of industrial investment in the EU during 1996 to three percent from an initial seven percent gain.
In Greece, investment was forecast to rise by 33 percent in volume terms, with the Netherlands expected to post a 22 percent increase and Britain 14 percent.

Separately, the Commission said economic sentiment across the EU rose modestly in December, with continued improvement in consumer attitudes towards spending offset by a further decline in confidence among manufacturers.
